faults.title: Crunchy or sticky gearchanges (Mk2)
faults.description: Auto Express says many 2014-2019 Mk2 i10s have crunchy gearshifts, usually fixed by adjusting the cable.

faults.title: Sticking rear brake pads and corroded discs (Mk2)
faults.description: Autocar reports some Mk2 owners found the brake pads sticking to the discs and not releasing. Make sure the handbrake holds, and check the rear discs for pitting from corrosion.

faults.title: Air-con problems (Mk2)
faults.description: Autocar says some Mk2 owners have had air-con problems linked to the type of refrigerant the system uses. Check it blows cold.

faults.title: Occasional minor electrical glitches (Mk3)
faults.description: What Car? says the 2020-on i10 is very dependable. No owners reported a fault in its latest survey, but earlier surveys showed occasional minor electrical glitches that didn't affect driving.
